issue.body:
Raised and independently reproduced 2026-10-08 America/Los_Angeles by Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affected corrective PR #1349, merge `5fa15de475f17ff93e205b767857d1e41a30949e`, head `982bfb84118a8c9fe8cf3e056389c97948291151`. Preserve closed #1332 and successful original #1116/#1120 correction, all #935/#948 evidence and separate source owners #932/#933/#930. This is a bounded remainder in the new packet's manifest builder.

The actual unchanged `build_manifest.py` has two independently reproduced failures:

1. It writes `reproducibility.json` with `outcome:passed` before checking the final `evidence-quality.json` destination or all remaining input/output pins. In a complete private copy of the merged campaign, remove only the disposable comparison copy and replace the disposable final-manifest copy with an existing sentinel. Invoke the ordinary builder CLI with Python 3.12.14. It exits 1 on the final collision but has already created the passed comparison, SHA256 `bd845629235f72a1fbc01c9bfcae6ba6b28e9cfbb40d696233be0d90e98a61d5`. The final sentinel remains unchanged (SHA `754d936020b0599198b8fe16244531fc05fd17dd79f80c8a756b155d415f90ad`). This violates complete-set admission: a known destination rejection must create no products. The ordinary early-comparison-collision case correctly rejects without new outputs; the complete positive case recreates the exact original final manifest SHA `cbab3413a6808f7dd3e06389b235f782ef2363a109b9397ebbc3d5ec8bc45aac`.
2. `issue_subjects()` reads a mutable issue snapshot, checks only lane/path/budget and 215 unique IDs, then the builder publishes those IDs without binding the accepted original snapshot or matching the actual completed run's identities. In another complete private copy, replace the contract's `atlas:city:PRY-4837` with the existing unrelated indexed ID `gb:AFG:ADM2:17698898B67359070524975`, leaving the 215 count, owned path, lane, budget, all six run outputs and publication receipts unchanged. Remove only the two disposable final output copies and invoke the unchanged ordinary builder. It exits 0 and publishes a manifest including the foreign Afghanistan subject and omitting Asunción, while its bound run-five audit still includes Asunción and excludes that foreign ID. The mutated full snapshot SHA is `15d8de4a6c67a88ea3a6f855f8f06f4d6158ccced1eebe9147f5ce075f070d5b`. Merely hashing the edited snapshot as a new output does not authenticate accepted scope or make the actual runs cover those subjects. This is a local producer defect; no claim is made that the trusted GitHub evidence gate would accept this changed contract.

The main `reproduce.py` repair succeeds: two auditor fresh complete runs reproduced all six deterministic original run-five products byte for byte, with seven outputs bound by each final publication receipt. Actual CLI controls reject snapshot/code drift, existing output, dangling vintage, symlink parent and traversal without altering fixture bytes or links. Its 22 original controls ran in each reproduction; eight additional independent parent/area mutation controls rejected. Independent complete 36-part index traversal found 49,625 unique IDs, all exact 215 subjects (167 Chile, 47 Paraguay, one Asunción), 39 complete parent joins and five inherited areas, including names/counts/flags. Preserve this success; do not weaken the main producer.

Inspected all 65 whole changed originals (2,002,803 logical bytes), 54 whole baseline files at `e9190786dbf758524a3bde513fc4bb4d1ed6a3e7`, all 64 manifest output pins, every retained run receipt, closed #1332 acceptance, exact-head review/check annotations and merge/closure records. The complete indexed baseline has 213,843,312 unique bytes; actual producer admitted 214,557,427 input/fixture/output bytes before its final publication. Entire operation remains within 256MiB and individual ordinary inputs below32MiB. All reproduction fixtures stayed in an admitted, auditor-owned sparse review slot; original files were read-only, and failed/partial outputs were preserved.

Success criteria:

- One additive PR in the disjoint owned prefix below; preserve all 65 originals/modes, exact 215/39/5 rosters, historical successful/draft/failed evidence and explicit source unknowns. Do not rewrite closed issues or consume other source workers' ownership.
- Bind the accepted immutable whole issue snapshot (original SHA `70e61fad77bb6b93376821cbe8b7c8c73439eac95ede07a45784758400ae23f6`), actual builder/producer/helper/import bytes, indexed baseline and complete run products/receipts. Independently reconcile every generated subject identity, subject digest and relevant metric to the accepted exact roster; a changed contract and copied comparison cannot redefine the scope of old runs.
- Admit the entire raw/decoded operation, runtime/result reserve and every final output destination before calculation or the first write. Use shared `Baseline`/`NewVintage` or an explicitly reviewed equivalent. Exclusive fresh runs, symlink/escape rejection, completion publication last and preserved partial failures apply to the documented builder as well as the producer. Known later collision must leave all destinations unchanged and create no output.
- Exercise real documented builder and producer entry points: original complete positive control; unchanged successful producer joins/controls; the exact late-manifest collision; first-destination collision; changed contract replacing one valid indexed subject while preserving count; issue/input/code drift; rerun, symlink/traversal and controlled publication failure. Verify complete output presence and whole hashes, not just equal subsets or helper-only behavior. Record function tests separately from CLI execution.
- Retain two actual fresh correction runs with whole consumed bytes, runtime, truthful per-run metadata, complete calculation/output hashes and failed-run receipts. Respect32MiB whole ordinary/decoded files and256MiB complete operation; no descriptor partitioning waiver. Obtain distinct substantive exact-head review of both failed invariants.

Deduplication: all-state API pagination 15 pages of100 plus final4 entries (1504 total issues/PRs), all five open PR file inventories, affected packet history and all open declared geography prefixes. The exact owned packet is referenced by closed #1332; ledger #726 holds PR identities; no matching remaining repair. Closed #1359 concerns the separate #1134/#948 area validator, not this #1349/#1120 manifest. Original dependency #1332 is closed with its canonical claim released/live_workfalse. No implementation reservation is acquired. Initially blocked until shared read-only readiness/dependency/ownership review.

Limits: strictly mechanical evidence/custody review. No source geometry or official legal/rights/current-condition approval, source acquisition, live import or deployment. Original #1120 remains separately Incomplete for source-content verification. Function-only `exclusive_write` parent-link/traversal acceptance was observed in disposable sibling paths, but the ordinary builder has fixed destinations; this issue does not claim an exploitable CLI path parameter. Any corrective PR receives its own audit; issue closure preserves the original audit outcome.
